## Shared i18n reader (READ ONLY)

Modes: repo_tree | repo_files | pr_diff (GitHub) | translation_lengths (Lokalise read-only). GET only. No personal credentials: Jira, Confluence and OneDrive are read by each user through their own connectors. Never add a node that writes anywhere.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jql: 'project = ' + String($json.jira_project || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/g, '') + ' AND labels in (Localization, localization) AND issuetype in (Bug, "Bug from UAT", Defect) AND (statusCategory != Done OR updated >= -365d) ORDER BY created DESC', fields: ['summary', 'status', 'created', 'labels', 'description'], maxResults: 100 }) }}

## i18n pre-check - MCP tool: read (READ ONLY)

Sub-workflow behind the i18n pre-check MCP server. Modes: product_info (Confluence) | repo_tree | repo_files | pr_diff (GitHub) | translation_lengths (Lokalise read-only) | localization_bugs (Jira). GET and search only. Never add a node that writes to GitHub, Lokalise, Jira or Confluence.
